places.name: Salt Creek
places.note: The herd rests two days; Indians on foot steal twelve horses, and the herd later grazes upstream while Call, Augustus and Deets pursue.
places.location_hint: Wyoming; flows to the Powder River

places.name: Starving Indian camp
places.note: A starving band eating a stolen horse; a young brave lances Deets as he lifts a blind child, and Call and Augustus shoot the boy.
places.location_hint: in a draw with a little water, barren salt-streaked country with ocher ridges, over a hundred miles southwest of Salt Creek; Augustus guesses the band is Ute

places.name: Powder River
places.note: Deets is buried on a rise just north of where Salt Creek joins it; Call carves and drives in a grave board.
places.location_hint: grave on a little rise north of the Salt Creek–Powder River junction, Wyoming

places.name: Deets's grave
places.note: Call's carved board praises Deets's thirty years of service; Augustus ties his faded border medal to it.
places.location_hint: on a small rise just north of where Salt Creek joins the Powder River, Wyoming

places.name: Wind River
places.note: Augustus jokes the thieves will reach it first, having heard it's drier than the Pecos country.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Used as Augustus's yardstick for dry country.

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Dying, Deets longs for the corrals by the old river and imagines lying beneath its brown water.
places.location_hint: the river by the outfit's old home in Texas

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call wishes they were already there; Augustus hopes it is nothing like this barren land.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Deets dies feeling they were wrong to leave it; Augustus's medal came from its Governor.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Sobbing at the grave, Lippy wishes he had never left it.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: camped by Deets's grave near where Salt Creek joins the Powder River, Wyoming
